steps: Open the games section and choose a partner game offer; read the milestone requirements on the offer before starting.
Play the game until you hit the required milestones — payment accrues per completed milestone, not per hour played.
Build your balance to $15.00 for a first-time payment request ($10 or higher for later requests).
Request payment via gift card, PayPal, or Visa.
Receive payment in about three business days; no additional fees per the help article.
